Frequently asked questions

Frequently asked questions

Does it work for active acne and for marks?

Yes. The laser helps control active acne and, in a different approach, improves the marks and scars it leaves. We adapt the protocol to each goal.

How many sessions do I need?

It depends on the acne type and your skin condition. A plan of several sessions is proposed and defined at the assessment.

When will I see results?

The skin improves progressively over the sessions; with active acne there is usually less shine and fewer breakouts.

Is there downtime?

It is a comfortable treatment with little or no recovery time, depending on the protocol.

Can it be combined with other care?

Yes, we can integrate it into a dermatological routine. We guide you at the assessment at our Barcelona clinic.
